title: On U_c-admitting spaces and U_c-completions of T_0 spaces
summary: In this paper, we introduce a new class of spaces, termed U_c-admitting spaces, and investigate their relationships with U_s-admitting spaces and well-filtered spaces. Adopting the perspective of H-sobriety, we show that every U_c-admitting space is H-sober, so that U_c-admitting spaces arise as a special case of H-sober spaces. Consequently, the category U_c-Sob of U_c-admitting spaces and continuous maps is complete and forms a reflective subcategory of Top_0.
